title: Text on a status-colour fill must reach 4.5:1 in every theme
rule: Do not reuse --fm-on-accent for text on a --fm-danger, --fm-warning or other status fill: that token is tuned for the accent only. Use the status colour as text on the surface (outlined button), or add a matching on-<status> token, and check 4.5:1 for light and dark including hover and pressed tints. Add a Playwright axe color-contrast check with the control visible in both colour schemes.
rationale: E50.13 (#584): the remove question's danger button inherited --fm-on-accent on a --fm-danger fill: 2.82:1 light, 2.28:1 dark.
